calls.title: Webinar Content Sync
calls.summary: Ben Fanning (Growth Engineer at Fixer) and Ashley Stirrup (GrowthBook) discussed Fixer’s evolution from manual experimentation to automated AI-driven workflows, focusing on pain points like repetitive manual analysis, experiment cleanup, and scaling experimentation. Key features covered include GrowthBook integration, AI agents for cleanup and reporting, a power calculator, and a learnings database.
